_doc: German SoFIFA / EA FC 27 PlayStyle name -> English name (the list of the EA pages, checked against 2,000 players that have both). A PlayStyle+ is the name with '+' behind. Names of the older games and spelling variants of the export are listed too. Names that are not here are NOT guessed: they are reported (see fcdb.PS_UNKNOWN). Answered by the user (2026-11-24): Trivela / Flair / Power-Kopfball / In der Luft / 1-gg-1 Zumachen as listed; Führungsstärke = Leadership (gives the skill Captaincy); the two CPU-KI traits give the COM styles Long Ranger / Early Cross when the values fit; Vereinstreue Spielerin, Teamspielerin, Zuverlässigkeit, Anfällig für Verletzungen and Harte Flanke stay out.
